statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete: 58/58 checks judged across seven representative paths.

page.notes: Public adult-video catalogue. Home, category index, category listing, video detail/watch entry, empty search, signup, and 404 recovery were sampled. Login, payment, authenticated account management, actual media streaming after verification, and exhaustive category/model/channel variants were not covered because they are gated or share audited templates.

paths.description: Homepage and primary catalogue template; desktop/mobile, preference, performance, privacy, accessibility and memory conditions.
Anal category representing filtered video-listing templates.
Video detail/watch-entry template and primary anonymous watch journey.
Empty search result and recovery state.
Public signup/account-creation surface for form, autofill and auth review.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark-colour preference.
findings.evidence: Dark-emulated screenshot is visually identical to the light capture; computed body remains rgb(244,244,244), color-scheme is normal, and the stylesheet probe found no prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences receive no adaptation.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot is unchanged, the CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, and axe found 63 contrast failures on the home page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and fix baseline colour contrast.

findings.summary: Page changes are abrupt full-document swaps.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probes across the MPA templates found no view-transition-name or @view-transition usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages have static chrome and no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The mobile home is 8,428px tall, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or position-aware header behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-position cue or responsive sticky chrome where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: Navigation does not cue where attention moved.
findings.evidence: Representative MPA route changes reload without directional transition, target highlight, breadcrumb, or other attention cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add breadcrumbs/current-location state and use directional transitions or target highlighting for route changes.

findings.summary: Responsiveness is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: All five template probes found no @container or container-type declarations despite reusable card grids and nav components.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container queries for reused cards and navigation components, retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Touch and keyboard affordances are inadequate.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size with 11 nodes; the probe found 36 visible controls below 24px on home and the first focused link had outline: none and no box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase targets to at least 24x24 CSS px with spacing and add a strong :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: The core watch flow is not predictably actionable.
findings.evidence: The detail page exposes a custom .fake-player anchor and div-based player shell; no native video/iframe was present before interaction, and the anonymous click did not produce verifiable playback state.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a clearly labelled, keyboard-operable video control and expose explicit loading, age-verification, failure, and playback states.

findings.summary: The 404 state is a dead end.
findings.evidence: A real 404 returns HTTP 404 but only renders “File not found.” with no title, viewport, navigation, search, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the normal shell around a helpful 404 message with search, home and back links.

findings.summary: Document latency and blocking delivery delay meaningful paint.
findings.evidence: Trace LCP was 2,497ms home and 2,376ms detail; HAR shows the main document taking about 2.27s plus parser-inserted blocking CSS and non-deferred bundle/rat.js candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document response time, defer noncritical scripts, preload only LCP-critical resources, and keep the critical dependency chain short.

findings.summary: Unused and third-party JavaScript dominates transfer.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags unused CSS and four unused-JS resources; HAR attributes 515,654 of 839,441 transferred bytes to scripts, led by duplicate Google tag payloads and Yandex.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics loaders, conditionally load third parties, and trim unused CSS/JS.

findings.summary: Important controls lack accessible names and labels.
findings.evidence: axe reports a critical unnamed search button and an unnamed footer-logo link; both search inputs have no label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control/link a programmatic name and associate visible or visually-hidden labels with search fields.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails at scale.
findings.evidence: axe reports 63 serious contrast failures on home and 48 on the video template, including dates, metadata and age-verification subtext.
findings.suggestedFix: Rework text tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state and retest both templates.

findings.summary: Main landmarks and visible focus are missing.
findings.evidence: axe reports no main landmark and content outside landmarks; the focused-link probe computed outline none and no box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main>, contain content in landmarks, and add consistent :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: Small targets and captionless custom media reduce access.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size failed on 11 nodes; the video probe found no caption/subtitle tracks and no native media element before activation.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target sizes and expose captions/transcripts through an accessible media player.

findings.summary: The video template logs browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console failed on the representative video page.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the reported runtime error and add production monitoring/regression coverage for console exceptions.

findings.summary: Image markup is structurally wasteful and one detail image is distorted.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 90/100 home images and 78/95 detail images without width/height; Lighthouse also failed image aspect ratio on detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and preserve source aspect ratios for all card and poster images.

findings.summary: DevTools issues and BFCache blockers remain.
findings.evidence: Both Lighthouse runs failed inspector-issues and BFCache diagnostics; the detail score was 0.69 for best practices.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the recorded inspector issues and remove avoidable unload/cache-control or runtime blockers to BFCache.

findings.summary: Several links are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse crawlable-anchors failed with five home links and four detail links; recon includes javascript:void(0) for “Our network”.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for navigable items and buttons for actions.

findings.summary: The sitemap signal uses an insecure URL.
findings.evidence: robots.txt advertises Sitemap: http://www.rat.xxx/sitemap.xml while public canonical URLs and the site are HTTPS.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish the sitemap reference over HTTPS and keep robots, canonical and sitemap URLs consistent.

findings.summary: Video entities lack structured data.
findings.evidence: The video page has useful Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD or other structured data for VideoObject despite representing a rich video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, description, thumbnail, duration and upload date.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP and nosniff are absent; 11 cookies were flagged insecure and PHPSESSID is not HttpOnly and uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and nosniff; mark session cookies Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Tracking is broad and starts without an observed consent choice.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence records six third-party origins and Google Analytics plus Yandex; HAR attributes 775,254/839,441 home bytes to non-main-origin requests and analytics cookies persist up to 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise analytics, defer it until a valid consent basis, shorten retention, and remove duplicate trackers.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and lacks modern credential support.
findings.evidence: The signup surface exposes username/email/password fields, no passkey/WebAuthn signal, no autocomplete tokens, and a five-character minimum.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/authentication and retain password fallback with modern password policy and autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers include X-Frame-Options and HSTS but omit Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/frame-ancestors and X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, add CSP frame-ancestors, and enable nosniff.

findings.summary: The manifest suggests an app but there is no offline worker.
findings.evidence: A standalone manifest with 192/512 icons is linked, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned an empty array.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a service worker with an offline shell/fallback, or remove the standalone app promise if installability is not intended.

findings.summary: The globally accessible layout is not writing-mode ready.
findings.evidence: html lang=en is correct, but all representative stylesheet probes found no logical sizing/spacing properties and no direction strategy.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt logical properties and verify the layout under rtl and translated strings.

findings.summary: Rendered dates are English-only relative strings.
findings.evidence: Cards render hard-coded-looking strings such as “9 years ago”; no locale selection or Intl-driven output was evident in representative DOM/CSS evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Format relative dates with Intl.RelativeTimeFormat and keep source timestamps machine-readable.

findings.summary: The privacy message conflicts with observed tracking.
findings.evidence: The prominent age-verification banner says “we don’t store personal data,” while the initial load sets analytics identifiers lasting up to 400 days and contacts Google/Yandex trackers before any observed choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the claim precise, disclose processors/retention, and gate nonessential tracking behind informed consent.

findings.summary: Signup fields lack humane validation semantics.
findings.evidence: The signup fields rely on placeholders, omit labels and required attributes, and provide empty generic field-error containers without observed accessible announcement semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Add labels, required/autocomplete/inputmode semantics, validate after interaction, and announce actionable errors with live regions.

findings.summary: Signup blocks useful autofill metadata.
findings.evidence: Username, email and password inputs all have empty autocomplete values; email is type=text rather than email.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username, email, new-password autocomplete tokens and semantic input types.

findings.summary: Account creation is weakly specified and not phishing-resistant.
findings.evidence: Signup uses a password with a five-character minimum, no passkey option, no visible field labels, and consent is bundled into the submit action.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys, strengthen account security, separate material consent where needed, and make commitments and recovery explicit.

findings.summary: Most images use legacy formats and lack responsive sources.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 96/100 home images in JPG/PNG/GIF and 62 without srcset; 90 lack intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, add srcset/sizes and dimensions, and preserve lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Analytics and advertising work is disproportionate to page value.
findings.evidence: On home, 59/62 requests and 775KB/839KB are outside the main origin; the largest scripts are duplicate Google tag payloads and Yandex. Detail adds a 155KB advertising origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics, reduce vendors, defer nonessential work and enforce a third-party byte/request budget.

taskList.title: Secure cookies and deploy CSP plus defensive response headers
Gate and drastically reduce Google/Yandex tracking
Fix accessible names, contrast, landmarks, focus and target size
Make playback and error recovery explicit and dependable
Modernise signup semantics, autofill and authentication with passkeys
Optimise responsive image delivery and intrinsic sizing
Reduce document latency and defer noncritical scripts
Improve crawlability and add VideoObject metadata
Add preference, container-query and guided-navigation support
Make the installable promise resilient offline
Adopt logical properties and locale-aware relative time
